statement.zh: 自然数的单位是一个损失的量子。不算入细分时，按比例的损失为被围住的家族交换的总量定下最小的界，连同最小尺度为被围住的交换、增长、下降、生起与止息的次数定下界；储备的最小下降为储备所推迟的终结定下界。
statement.en: The natural-number unit is a quantum of loss. Without counting the refinement, loss in proportion sets the least bound on what an enclosed family exchanges and, with a least size, bounds the times of exchange, growth, fall, arising and ceasing; a least fall of the reserve bounds the end it defers.

laws.zh: 脊柱以一个固定单位的自然数计量，所以耗散每次交换至少损失一个单位；停息与开放的规律依赖这一量子。
laws.en: The spine counts amounts in natural numbers of one fixed unit, so dissipation loses at least a unit at every exchange, and the rest and openness laws rely on that quantum.

laws.zh: 把单位的细分算作只给不取的形成时，脊柱的前提不添任何前提就带来每一分辨率下的停息（rest-with-refinement-counted）；这里的规律是不算入细分时的规律，作为研究笔记保留。
laws.en: With the splitting of the unit counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added (rest-with-refinement-counted); the laws here are those without counting the refinement, kept as research notes.

laws.zh: 让单位跨过第 t 步分为 r t 个更细的单位（r 恒为一时就是 Balances），R 计每一步的单位数，以第 T 步的单位为一。
laws.en: Let the unit split into r t finer units across the step from t (with r constantly one it is Balances), and let R count the units of each step, the unit of step T being one.

laws.zh: 损失的规律：从 T 起每步，q 乘余下的连同 k 个量子不多于 q 乘此前所有的时，自 T 起计到的量子不多于 q 乘该量在 T 的值。
laws.en: The loss law: where across each step from T on q times what remains together with k quanta is within q times what was there, the quanta counted since T number at most q times the quantity at T.

laws.zh: 所以在细分分辨率下平衡且耗散时，从 T 起封闭的不重复家族损失至少 1/q 第 T 步单位的步不多于 q 乘其存量，不复现；单位固定时取用封闭家族不复现。
laws.en: So, balanced at a refining resolution and dissipative, a family without repetition closed from T on loses at least 1/q of the unit of step T at no more steps than q times its stock, and losing so does not recur; with the unit fixed, taking from a closed family does not recur.

laws.zh: 按比例的损失：每个封闭家族得回的至多是从它取走的 q/(q+1)；每个形成给回的至多是所取的 q/(q+1) 时如此。
laws.en: Loss in proportion: every closed family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it; so it is where each formation gives back at most q/(q+1) of what it takes.

laws.zh: 有按比例的损失时，量的规律在每一分辨率下成立：从 T 起封闭的不重复家族被取走的总量，每步的量以第 T 步的单位计，至多是它在 T 的存量的 q+1 倍，得回的总量至多 q 倍。
laws.en: With loss in proportion the amount law holds at every resolution: everything taken from a family without repetition closed from T on, each step's amount counted in the unit of step T, is at most q + 1 times its stock at T, and everything given back at most q times.

laws.zh: 在有普查、关系项都体现、从 T 起每步被围住的世界中，从所立者被取走的总量至多是 T 时所立者总水平的 q+1 倍，给予所立者的至多 q 倍。
laws.en: In a world with a census, embodied relata and every step from T on enclosed, everything taken from what stands is at most q + 1 times the total standing at T, and everything given to what stands at most q times.

laws.zh: 这个界是最小的：Geometric 中一个形成每步取走整个封闭的池、给回 q/(q+1)，单位每步分为 q+1 个，被取走的总量对每个 m 都到达 q+1 乘池的 1/m 之内。
laws.en: The bound is the least: in Geometric one formation takes the whole of a closed pool at each step and gives back q/(q+1) of it, at a unit splitting into q + 1 at each step, and everything taken comes within 1/m of q + 1 times the pool for every m.

laws.zh: 每个尺度的计数都由量的规律得出：每步的计数不多于 p 乘一个量时，自 T 起的计数不多于 p 乘该量的界。
laws.en: Every count of a size follows from the amount law: where each step's count is within p times an amount, the count since T is within p times the amount's bound.

laws.zh: 交换的规律：从 T 起封闭的家族中，取用至少 1/p 单位的形成逐个逐步计数，总数不多于 p(q+1) 乘其在 T 的存量。
laws.en: The exchange law: the formations taking at least 1/p of the unit from a family closed from T on, counted formation by formation and step by step, number at most p(q+1) times its stock at T.

laws.zh: 增长的规律：在有普查、关系项都体现、从 T 起每步被围住的世界中，增长至少 1/p 单位的关系项逐个逐步计数，总数不多于 p q 乘 T 时所立者的总水平，所以这样的增长不复现，这一尺度的生起也不在任意晚的步发生。
laws.en: The growth law: in a world with a census, embodied relata and every step from T on enclosed, the relata gaining at least 1/p of the unit, counted relatum by relatum and step by step, number at most p q times the total standing at T, so such gains do not recur and nothing arises at that size at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 下降的规律：下降至少 1/p 单位的关系项逐个逐步计数，总数不多于 p(q+1) 乘 T 时所立者的总水平，所以立于至少 1/p 单位者的止息也不复现：在每一分辨率下，这一尺度的生起与止息都不复现。
laws.en: The fall law: the relata falling by at least 1/p of the unit, counted relatum by relatum and step by step, number at most p(q+1) times the total standing at T, so nothing standing at least 1/p of the unit ceases at arbitrarily late steps: at every resolution neither arising nor ceasing at that size recurs.

laws.zh: 储备：每个活跃而不被支持的步使储备至少下降 1/p 单位时，从 T 起不被支持的形成活跃的步不多于 p 乘其在 T 的储备；脊柱的储备是 p 为一、单位固定的情形，细分单位下只要求储备下降的读法在单位固定时就是脊柱的储备。
laws.en: Reserve: where each active step beyond support lowers the reserve by at least 1/p of the unit, a formation unsupported from T on is active at most p times its reserve at T; the spine's reserve is the case of p one at a fixed unit, and the reading in a refining unit that asks only that the reserve fall is, with the unit fixed, the spine's reserve.

laws.zh: 每一尺度的最小损失：脊柱的耗散之下，取用至少 1/p 单位的形成都失去至少 1/m 单位时，从 T 起封闭的家族中这样的取用逐个逐步计数不多于 m 乘其在 T 的存量；逐个形成按比例的损失给出这样的最小损失。
laws.en: A least loss at each size: with the spine's dissipation, where each formation taking at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it, such takings from a family closed from T on, counted formation by formation and step by step, number at most m times its stock at T; loss in proportion at each transfer gives such a least loss.

laws.zh: 计数转移只需每一尺度的最小损失，计数关系项的增长与为交换的总量定界需要更多。
laws.en: Counting transfers needs only a least loss at each size; counting what relata gain, and bounding the amount exchanged, needs more.

laws.zh: 缺少其中任何一个前提，变化都可以无尽地继续；见证都在无尽细分的单位下平衡并耗散。Asymptote 失去其所取用的全部，所以按每个比例耗散，恰在单位无尽地细分时无尽地被取用，在固定单位下不平衡。
laws.en: Without any one of these premises change can continue without end; the witnesses are each balanced at a unit splitting without end and dissipative. Asymptote, losing all it takes and so dissipative in every proportion, is taken from without end exactly where the unit splits without end, and does not balance at the fixed unit.

laws.zh: Circulation 每步交换第 0 步的一整个单位，每步围住所立者，损失下一步的一个单位，不按任何比例耗散。
laws.en: Circulation exchanges one whole unit of step 0 at every step, every step enclosed around what stands, losing one unit of the step after, and is dissipative in no proportion.

laws.zh: Emission 有普查、关系项都体现、每步被围住、失去所取用的一半，每步生起一个新关系项，立于下一步的一个单位，在固定单位下不平衡。
laws.en: Emission, with a census, embodied relata, every step enclosed and half of what is taken lost, has a new relatum arise at every step, standing at one unit of the step after, and does not balance at the fixed unit.

laws.zh: Alternation 有普查、关系项都体现、每步被围住，两侧轮流持有并生起第 0 步的一整个单位，不按任何比例耗散，在固定单位下不平衡。
laws.en: Alternation, with a census, embodied relata and every step enclosed, has two sides hold and arise with one whole unit of step 0 in turn, is dissipative in no proportion, and does not balance at the fixed unit.

laws.zh: Dwindle 中单位每步减半，一个从不被支持的形成每步都活跃，储备在更细单位下每步下降而以第 0 步单位计趋于一个单位，对任何 p，每个活跃的步都不使储备下降 1/p 单位。
laws.en: In Dwindle, at a unit halving at each step, a formation never supported is active at every step, its reserve falling in the finer unit at each and tending to one unit of step 0, with no fall of the reserve by 1/p of the unit at each active step for any p.

laws.zh: Trickle 中单位每步分为四个，第 0 步的一整个单位在两侧之间由越来越多、越来越小的转移带过，每份失去下一步的两个单位，每一尺度都有最小损失，每个固定尺度的转移停止，而一整个单位在任意晚的步生起，不按任何比例耗散。
laws.en: In Trickle, at a unit quartering at each step, a whole unit of step 0 passes between two sides in ever more, ever smaller transfers, each losing two units of the step after, so every size has a least loss and transfers of each fixed size stop, yet a whole unit arises at arbitrarily late steps, with no proportion lost.

hypotheses.zh: 分辨率：R T = 1，从 T 起 R (t + 1) = r t · R t 且 0 < r t，即单位只细分；每一步的量仍是该步单位的自然数。这些是定理的假设，不是公理。
hypotheses.en: Resolution: R T = 1 and, from T on, R (t + 1) = r t · R t with 0 < r t, so the unit only splits; amounts at each step stay natural numbers of that step's unit. These are hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

hypotheses.zh: 按比例的损失（Flow.DissipativeBy q）：在每个跨过一步封闭的不重复家族上，家族得回的至多是从它取走的 q/(q+1)；每个参与的形成给回的至多是所取的 q/(q+1) 时如此（Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each），反之不然。
hypotheses.en: Loss in proportion (Flow.DissipativeBy q): on every family without repetition closed across a step, the family gets back at most q/(q+1) of what is taken from it; it holds where each formation taking part gives back at most q/(q+1) of what it takes (Flow.DissipatesBy.of_each), not conversely.

hypotheses.zh: 它是前提，是脊柱一单位损失的无单位对应，不是推出的；作者读作家族的交换合起来的效率上界。
hypotheses.en: It is a premise, the unit-free counterpart of the spine's one-unit loss, not derived; the author reads it as an upper bound on the efficiency of the family's exchanges taken together.

hypotheses.zh: Ren 2026-10-11 选择每次交换至少一个最小差异（“A is right”），未采用它为理论的前提；这一线作为研究笔记保留（sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md）。
hypotheses.en: On 11 October 2026 Ren chose a least difference at every exchange (‘A is right’) and did not take this as a premise of the theory; the line is kept as research notes (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md).

hypotheses.zh: 最小损失的交换律：脊柱的耗散（每个取用的形成给回封闭家族的至少比所取少下一步的一个单位；证明只用其不多于所取），以及每一尺度的最小损失（Flow.LosesAtSize：取用至少 1/p 单位的形成失去至少 1/m 单位，m 不随步变化）。
hypotheses.en: The exchange law at a least loss: the spine's dissipation (each formation taking gives a closed family back at least one unit of the step after less than it takes; the proof uses only that it gives no more than it takes) and a least loss at each size (Flow.LosesAtSize: a formation taking at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it, m the same at every step).

hypotheses.zh: 世界的规律：活动的普查、每个关系项都体现、从 T 起每步被围住，与停息定理（continued-change-needs-openness）相同。交换的规律只对从 T 起固定的封闭家族陈述。
hypotheses.en: The world laws: a census of activity, every relatum embodied and every step from T on enclosed, as in the rest theorem (continued-change-needs-openness). The exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on.

hypotheses.zh: 储备的规律：从 T 起不被支持；活动可判定。储备的最小下降（每个活跃的步至少 1/p 单位）是前提，是脊柱一单位下降的无单位对应；细分算入时，凡细分不给储备之处它就是脊柱的储备（Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined，见 rest-with-refinement-counted）。
hypotheses.en: The reserve law: unsupported from T on; activity decidable. The least fall of the reserve (at least 1/p of the unit at each active step) is a premise, the unit-free counterpart of the spine's one-unit fall; with the refinement counted, wherever it gives the reserve nothing the reserve is the spine's (Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined, see rest-with-refinement-counted).

does_not_show.zh: 量是细分后的有理数，单位不变粗，不含实数量与连续时间。
does_not_show.en: Amounts are rationals by refinement, the unit never coarsening, with neither real amounts nor continuous time.

does_not_show.zh: 量的规律的界是最小的，计数的界是否可达未证：一次独立审查的探针 Tight.attained 给出交换的界在 p = q = S = 1 时达到，未移入核心。
does_not_show.en: The amount law's bound is the least, while whether the counting bounds are attained is not proved in the core: the review's probe Tight.attained attains the exchange bound at p = q = S = 1 and is not moved into the core.

does_not_show.zh: 交换的规律只对从 T 起固定的封闭家族陈述，没有以变化的围住读于世界。
does_not_show.en: The exchange law is stated for a fixed family closed from T on, not read of worlds with changing enclosures.

does_not_show.zh: 按比例的损失与储备的最小下降是前提，未采用为理论的前提，作为研究笔记保留。
does_not_show.en: Loss in proportion and the least fall of the reserve are premises not taken for the theory, kept as research notes.

does_not_show.zh: 比对家族的比例更弱而仍给出增长的规律的前提由审查的探针给出（ReplenishedLoses），未移入核心。
does_not_show.en: A premise weaker than the family's proportion that still gives the growth law is given by the review's probes (ReplenishedLoses), not moved into the core.

does_not_show.zh: 见证都小：Asymptote、Circulation 与 Dwindle 只有一个关系项，Alternation 两个，Emission 每步加入一个；Trickle 的通道不活跃。
does_not_show.en: The witnesses are small: Asymptote, Circulation and Dwindle have one relatum, Alternation two, and Emission adds one at every step; the conduits of Trickle are not active.

does_not_show.zh: 每个见证说明在其余前提之下它所缺的前提是需要的，不说明全部前提彼此独立，不描述实际系统。
does_not_show.en: Each witness shows the premise it lacks is needed given the others, not that all premises are mutually independent, and none describes an actual system.

does_not_show.zh: “不复现”是复现的否定，不是某步之后不再发生。
does_not_show.en: ‘Does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing happens.

detail.zh: Asymptote：失去所取用的全部，按每个比例耗散，池每步封闭，取用者每步受支持；恰在单位无尽地细分时取用无尽（Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff），所取用的缩小到每个量子之下，流在固定单位下不平衡（Asymptote.not_balanced）。所以最小尺度不能去掉。算入细分，细分供给它（refinement_feeds_witnesses）。
detail.en: Asymptote: losing all it takes, dissipative in every proportion, the pool closed and the drawer supported at every step; taking continues without end exactly where the unit splits without end (Asymptote.exchange_recurs_iff), what is taken shrinking below every quantum, and the flow does not balance at the fixed unit (Asymptote.not_balanced). So the least size cannot be dropped. Counted, the refinement feeds it (refinement_feeds_witnesses).

detail.zh: Circulation：所立者被列出、平衡于减半的单位、耗散、每步围住所立者，每步交换第 0 步的一整个单位；由交换的规律，它不按任何比例耗散（Circulation.not_dissipativeBy）。所以单位固定时交换不复现（World.exchange_not_recurring）依赖量子，而按比例的损失不能去掉。
detail.en: Circulation: what stands listed, balanced at a halving unit, dissipative, every step enclosed around what stands, one whole unit of step 0 exchanged at every step; by the exchange law it is dissipative in no proportion (Circulation.not_dissipativeBy). So that the exchange does not recur with a fixed unit (World.exchange_not_recurring) relies on the quantum, and loss in proportion cannot be dropped.

detail.zh: Emission：满足 World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed 的全部前提，只是平衡在减半的单位下，并按比例耗散（给回所取用的一半），每步生起一个新关系项，立于下一步的一个单位；世界在固定单位下不平衡（Emission.not_balanced）。所以停息定理依赖量子，按比例的损失没有最小尺度时也不足够。
detail.en: Emission: meets every premise of World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed but with balance at a halving unit, and is dissipative in proportion (giving back half of what it takes), with a new relatum arising at every step, standing at one unit of the step after; the world does not balance at the fixed unit (Emission.not_balanced). So the rest theorem relies on the quantum, and loss in proportion without a least size does not suffice.

detail.zh: Alternation：满足 World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed 的全部前提，只是平衡在减半的单位下，两侧轮流生起第 0 步的一整个单位；由增长的规律，它不按任何比例耗散（Alternation.not_dissipativeBy），世界在固定单位下不平衡（Alternation.not_balanced）。所以最小尺度没有按比例的损失时也不足够。
detail.en: Alternation: meets every premise of World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed but with balance at a halving unit, the two sides arising with one whole unit of step 0 in turn; by the growth law it is dissipative in no proportion (Alternation.not_dissipativeBy), and the world does not balance at the fixed unit (Alternation.not_balanced). So a least size without loss in proportion does not suffice.

detail.zh: Dwindle：单位每步减半，一个从不被支持的形成每步都活跃，储备以当步单位计为 2^t + 1，在更细单位下每步下降（Dwindle.carriesIn），以第 0 步单位计从上方趋于一个单位，永不到零；对任何 p，每个活跃的步不都使储备下降 1/p 单位（Dwindle.not_carriesAt、reserve_needs_quantum）。单位固定时这样的储备就是脊柱的储备（Web.carriesIn_one），由 Web.Carries.lasts 不能如此。所以储备推迟终结而不逃脱依赖量子，每一分辨率下要每个活跃的步储备的最小下降；算入细分，细分每步给予这个储备（refinement_feeds_witnesses）。
detail.en: Dwindle: at a unit halving at each step, a formation never supported is active at every step, its reserve, 2^t + 1 in the unit of step t, falling in the finer unit at each step (Dwindle.carriesIn) and tending from above to one unit of step 0, never reaching zero; for no p does each active step lower the reserve by 1/p of the unit (Dwindle.not_carriesAt, reserve_needs_quantum). With the unit fixed such a reserve is the spine's (Web.carriesIn_one), which Web.Carries.lasts forbids. So that a reserve defers the end without escaping it relies on the quantum, and at every resolution needs a least fall of the reserve at each active step; counted, the refinement gives this reserve something at every step (refinement_feeds_witnesses).

detail.zh: Trickle：单位每步分为四个；两侧轮流持有第 0 步的一整个单位，第 t 步由 2^t 个水平为零的通道（Trickle.conduits）分成 2^t 份交给另一侧，每份失去下一步的两个单位。它有普查、关系项都体现、平衡、耗散、每步被围住；每一尺度都有最小损失（Trickle.losesAtEverySize），每个固定尺度的转移都不复现（Trickle.exchange_not_recurring）；一整个单位在任意晚的步生起，不按任何比例耗散（Trickle.not_dissipativeBy、growth_needs_proportion）。被取走的总量超过第 0 步单位的每个倍数（Trickle.throughput_unbounded、throughput_needs_proportion）。所以每一尺度的最小损失给出交换的规律，不给出增长的规律与量的规律；一次独立审查的探针表明 Trickle 所用的是每步无界多的转移（growth_needs_bounded_transfers，未移入核心）。通道不活跃；要求只有活跃者取用的变体没有构造。
detail.en: Trickle: at a unit quartering at each step, two sides hold one whole unit of step 0 in turn, and at step t it passes to the other side in 2^t parts carried by 2^t conduits standing at nothing (Trickle.conduits), each part losing two units of the step after. It has a census, embodied relata, balance, dissipation and every step enclosed; every size has a least loss (Trickle.losesAtEverySize) and transfers of each fixed size do not recur (Trickle.exchange_not_recurring); a whole unit arises at arbitrarily late steps, with no proportion lost (Trickle.not_dissipativeBy, growth_needs_proportion). Everything taken from the two sides grows past every multiple of the unit of step 0 (Trickle.throughput_unbounded, throughput_needs_proportion). So a least loss at each size gives the exchange law but neither the growth law nor the amount law; an independent review's probes show that what Trickle uses is unboundedly many transfers within one step (growth_needs_bounded_transfers, not moved into the core). The conduits are not active; a variant in which only active formations take is not constructed.

correspondence.zh: 单位固定时的停息定理（continued-change-needs-openness）是 r = 1 并带脊柱一单位损失的情形；本结果说明那里的损失是由单位承载的一个量子，并给出不算入细分时每一分辨率下成立的规律。Ren 2026-10-11 说每次交换至少一个最小差异属于生成本身（“A is right - because of change, there is difference”），并问零前提的情形（sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md）；把单位的细分算作只给不取的形成，脊柱的前提不添前提就带来每一分辨率下的停息，本记录的见证都由细分供给（rest-with-refinement-counted）。作者的读法（AI 论证，依 Ren 的交托采用）：不算入细分时，以第 T 步的单位计，所立者的总水平是一个有理量，细分单位以更细的分辨率表示量；按比例的损失是效率的上界；1/p 是计数变化所用的尺度。在这一读法下，有界效率之下被围住的生成，任何固定尺度的都会停止；在围住之内只能以越来越细或越来越接近无损的方式继续。这回答了 continued-change-needs-openness 的下一步“带比率或连续量的总水平”中有理量与离散步的部分；连续时间与实数量仍开放。计数转移只需每一尺度的最小损失；计数关系项得到的，需要多于每一尺度转移的最小损失，因为一整个单位可以由越来越多、越来越小的转移带过（Trickle）。对家族总和的前提不受分割影响：比例如此，第十五次独立审查的探针 ReplenishedLoses（被给予至少 1/p 单位的封闭家族至少失去 1/m 单位）也如此，它严格弱于比例而仍给出增长的规律；分割打败的只是逐个转移的前提。此前这里说计数关系项“需要对家族的比例”，“只有损失随所转移的量成比例，分割才不能把损失分没”，是过度的必要性陈述，按第十五次独立审查 W1 更正。Ren 关于研究笔记（2026-10-11）：“they seem to be good research subjects, but this is separate matter, we can leave a note”。
correspondence.en: The rest theorem with a fixed unit (continued-change-needs-openness) is the case r = 1 with the spine's one-unit loss; this result shows that the loss there is a quantum carried by the unit and gives the laws holding at every resolution without counting the refinement. On 11 October 2026 Ren said that a least difference at every exchange belongs to becoming itself (‘A is right - because of change, there is difference’) and asked about the case of zero premises (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-11-difference-in-becoming.md); with the splitting of the unit counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added, and the witnesses of this record are each fed by the refinement (rest-with-refinement-counted). The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): without counting the refinement, the total standing counted in the unit of step T is a rational quantity, refining the unit representing amounts at finer resolution; loss in proportion is an upper bound on efficiency; 1/p is the size at which change is counted. On this reading, with bounded efficiency, enclosed generation of any fixed size stops, and inside an enclosure it can continue only ever finer or ever closer to lossless. This answers, for rational amounts and discrete steps, the next step of continued-change-needs-openness, ‘total standing with rates or continuous amounts’; continuous time and real amounts remain open. Counting transfers needs only a least loss at each size; counting what relata gain needs more than a least loss at each size of transfer, since a whole unit can pass in ever more, ever smaller transfers (Trickle). A premise on the family's totals is immune to splitting: so is the proportion, and so is the fifteenth independent review's probe ReplenishedLoses (a closed family given at least 1/p of the unit loses at least 1/m of it), which is strictly weaker than the proportion and still gives the growth law; what splitting defeats is a premise per transfer. This passage earlier said that counting what relata gain ‘needs the family's share’ and that ‘only a loss in proportion to what is transferred cannot be split away’; both overclaimed necessity and are corrected following W1 of the fifteenth independent review. Ren on the research notes (11 October 2026): ‘they seem to be good research subjects, but this is separate matter, we can leave a note’.
